components.name: Primary button
components.description: Coral action used in project forms and preview setup.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;border-radius:8px;min-height:40px;font:14px/1.6 Inter, 'Inter Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out;background:#fa8198;color:#221417;padding:10px 17px;font-weight:600;border:0}.ds-primary:hover{background:#ff9aab}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fa8198;outline-offset:4px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Quiet button
components.description: Outlined secondary action used in navigation and forms.

components.name: Text button

components.name: Text field
components.description: Inset field used by board sign-in and project forms.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font:12px/1.6 Inter, 'Inter Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;color:#b2adb4}.ds-field input{background:#19171c;color:#f3f0ed;border:1px solid #4e444f;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;font:14px/1.6 Inter, 'Inter Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;caret-color:#fa8198}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#aaa4ad;opacity:1}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fa8198;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Header navigation
components.description: Landing wordmark, secondary links, and sign-in action; mascot asset stays in the implementation.
components.html: clankPricing
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;color:#b2adb4;font:13px/1.6 Inter, 'Inter Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-nav .ds-wordmark{color:#f3f0ed;font-size:21px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-.04em}.ds-nav a:hover{color:#f3f0ed}.ds-nav button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;border-radius:8px;min-height:40px;font:14px/1.6 Inter, 'Inter Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out;margin-left:auto;padding:8px 14px;border:1px solid #38383d;background:transparent;color:#f3f0ed}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#262629}.ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fa8198;outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav,.ds-wordmark{transition:none}}

components.name: Target choice
components.description: Radio-backed web/mobile selection in the new project form.
components.css: .ds-targets{display:flex;gap:10px;color:#f3f0ed;font:13px/1.6 Inter, 'Inter Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-targets label{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:1;gap:8px;border:1px solid #49414b;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 13px;cursor:pointer}.ds-targets input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}.ds-targets label:has(input:checked){border-color:#c16a82;background:#30232b;color:#f4b5c7}.ds-targets label:focus-within{outline:2px solid #fa8198;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Project widget shell
components.description: Tinted drag header and bordered project surface; this sample omits the runtime chat and iframe.
components.html:
Your projectReady

components.css: .ds-project{border:1px solid #4a424c;border-radius:14px;background:#1e1e21;color:#f3f0ed;overflow:hidden;font:14px/1.6 Inter, 'Inter Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-project header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:49px;padding:0 16px;background:#242126;border-bottom:1px solid #39313b;color:#cbbfcf;font-size:13px}.ds-project strong{color:#f3f0ed;font-weight:500}.ds-project header span{font-size:11px}.ds-project>div{padding:28px}

components.name: Chat composer
components.description: Inset conversation composer with a trailing send action.
components.html: Describe a change. Make it yours.
components.css: .ds-composer{margin:12px;padding:12px;background:#29232c;border:1px solid #504151;border-radius:10px;color:#f3f0ed;font:14px/1.6 Inter, 'Inter Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-composer:focus-within{border-color:#fa8198}.ds-composer textarea{width:100%;min-height:63px;max-height:180px;background:transparent;border:0;font:13px/1.6 Inter, 'Inter Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;color:#f3f0ed;caret-color:#fa8198;resize:vertical}.ds-composer textarea::placeholder{color:#aaa4ad;opacity:1}.ds-composer textarea:focus{outline:none}.ds-composer>div{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:12px}.ds-composer span{font-size:9px;line-height:1.5;color:#b2adb4}.ds-composer button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:36px;height:36px;flex-shrink:0;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:#fa8198;color:#23161a;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out}.ds-composer button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fa8198;outline-offset:4px}.ds-composer button:disabled{background:#54414a;color:#b6a4ac;cursor:not-allowed}@media(max-width:699px){.ds-composer textarea{font-size:16px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-composer{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
Clank uses a clean graphite field, warm white text, coral selection paths, and the existing mascot. Controls stay compact while the canvas gives ideas room to grow. Surface borders and restrained tonal shifts organize the interface.

This document covers only the landing page and builder board rendered inside `.clank-builder`, including the board's embedded sign-in and project forms. Pricing, account, onboarding, and other existing pages retain their incumbent system. Implementation evidence lives in `src/lib/builder/`, with shared font definitions in `src/app.css`; surface composition belongs in `.impeccable/landing.brief.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite surfaces with warm white text and coral interaction accents.
Compact controls, softly rounded containers, and thin structural borders.
A fading dot field on entry and a pannable project board.
dos: Do preserve the recognizable Clank mascot and shared SVG icon geometry.
Do use coral to make actions, selection, and keyboard focus visible.
Do retain the board's readable widget widths and narrow-screen Chat/Preview tabs.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences for the dot field and control transitions.
donts: Don't apply this scoped palette to existing pricing, account, or onboarding pages.
Don't use tiny status-label sizes as the default for operational text.
Don't let canvas dragging consume normal interaction inside forms, transcripts, or previews.
